summary: Split 5: verify the split on Windows and WSL builds and in game
author: pm
body:
Build Debug and Release on Windows and the WSL client; manual check at 800x600, 1440x1080, fullscreen letterbox and fullscreen stretch.

**Done when:** all builds pass and the in-game check is recorded on this ticket.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Ready for your eye. Done: Windows Debug, Windows Release and WSL Debug builds all pass (measured, repeatedly through 2026-11-24). In game at 1920x1440 windowed: world, dialog and chat-bubble screenshots are in build/screenshots/hh0014_*_1920x1440.png (taken through the agent bridge, test account). Not covered: 800x600, 1440x1080, fullscreen stretch and letterbox, because the in-game menu has no resolution or fullscreen control and settings.json was left untouched. Please check those sizes and tight right-aligned text yourself; tell me in chat what you see.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: **Verified, 2026-11-24:** (confidence ~95%) Builds: Windows Debug, Windows Release and WSL Debug passed (pm, measured earlier). In game through the agent bridge with the test account, Debug client: 800x600 windowed, 1440x1080 windowed, fullscreen letterbox (3440x1440 desktop, 4:3 world centred, black bars, UI sharp at window resolution) and fullscreen stretch (world stretched, UI uniform scale and centred, action bar spans the window, as the plan's decision 1 says). Dialogs (system menu, inventory) render at window resolution at every size. Fullscreen is reached from System Menu > Graphics > Display Mode (scroll down); Aspect Ratio there switches letterbox/stretch. Screenshots: build/screenshots/vur_hh0014_world_800x600.jpg, vur_sysmenu_800.jpg, vur_hh0014_world_1440x1080.jpg, vur_hh0014_dialogs_1440x1080.jpg, vur_hh0014_fullscreen_letterbox.jpg, vur_hh0014_fullscreen_stretch.jpg. Not checked: Linux fullscreen. settings.json restored to its original afterwards.
